Card Q&A.q: If I have a suspended Digimon with [Vegetation], [Plant], or [Fairy] in one of its traits, can I choose to suspend this Digimon itself with this card's [When Digivolving], gain 2 memory, then unsuspend this Digimon and gain ?
If I have 4 suspended Digimon, does this Digimon gain +4000 DP and  twice?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, this Digimon counts if it's suspended.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card itself count as a suspended Digimon for this card's [Your Turn] effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 of your Digimon. Then, gain 1 memory for each suspended Digimon with [Vegetation], [Plant], or [Fairy] in one of their traits you have in play. If you gain 2 or more memory by this effect, unsuspend this Digimon and it gains ＜Piercing＞ for the turn.
[Your Turn] For every 2 suspended Digimon you have in play, this Digimon gets +2000 DP and gains ＜Security Attack +1＞.
